verdict.rationale: Shopify documents webhook topics that deliver near-real-time event data and describes webhooks as "a trigger to perform an additional action after that event has occurred." That gives you the event-trigger half of the story. The rules and actions, however, must be built and hosted in your own app code using the Admin API. The evidence shows no native rule builder or no-code workflow engine. Missing for 10: a first-party rule/condition-action automation feature (no-code or declarative), documentation of built-in actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
